subject: design/feature-draft
statement: A missing exact-head operator approval names the feature and head and directs an operator review before lock recording.
intent: Make agent, stale, or forged approval refusals actionable in the end-to-end lock flow.
rationale: A lock tag cannot be created from an agent review or an operator review of an older head; the refusal carries the exact item and remedy.
fit_criterion: The fresh-clone abuse fixture refuses both reviews, names the feature/head and operator approval action, and writes no lock tag.
